comparison.objective: Release an extruder idler and extract broken filament, versus adjust and lock a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual lever holding and linear extraction differ from tool insertion, fine rotary tuning, counterholding, and locking torque.
comparison.success_condition: Filament removed to tray and lever restored versus repeatable safe damping and verified collar retention.
comparison.reason: Both are equipment service tasks, but their mechanisms and required evidence are materially different.
